fuel_consumption.source_quote: The Company currently expects to consume approximately 2.2 billion gallons of jet fuel in 2025.

instrument_type_details.notes: As of 12/31/2024, fuel derivative instruments consist solely of Brent crude oil option contracts ($130M Level 3). Cash collateral held from counterparties: $22M. All WTI-based derivatives were de-designated from hedge accounting in Q3 2024 (lost correlation with jet fuel prices) and fully settled by 12/31/2024. Portfolio is now exclusively Brent crude oil. pct_hedged_next_year ~47% estimated as 1,033M gallons / 2,200M gallons expected 2025 consumption. Company announced it does not intend to add new hedging positions.

warnings: pct_hedged_next_year (47%) is estimated as 1,033M gallons / 2,200M gallons expected 2025 consumption; not explicitly stated in filing.

Company announced: 'Based on the current geopolitical and market dynamics, higher premium costs over time, and aggressive cost reductions underway, the Company does not intend to add new hedging positions to its current hedge book.' Program effectively in wind-down as of this filing.

WTI crude oil derivatives de-designated from hedge accounting in Q3 2024; change in fair value of WTI derivatives ($37M decrease) recorded to Other (gains) losses for H2 2024. All WTI contracts settled by 12/31/2024. Current portfolio is exclusively Brent-based.
